title: docs(code samples): change syntax theme, add copy button
body:
This commit changes the syntax theme to use GitHub colors and adds a
little header much like on reactjs docs.

It also adds a copy button.

Before:
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/22340288/3983154c-e3ed-11e6-939f-371e5432655f.png)

After:
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/22340435/c0e1f580-e3ed-11e6-9f46-661442c03981.png)

Also this:
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/22340446/ca75b91a-e3ed-11e6-9c90-170e20a9aa70.png)

Copy button:
![copy-paste](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/22340667/7d9a3bd8-e3ee-11e6-94f6-c8c04f1c4805.gif)

comments.body: Is it possible to style the copy button? :)

Yes, I wondered if maybe a simpler text only button could do it and would be more obvious:

```
[ COPY ]
```

```
[ COPIED ! ]
```

?
RIght now this is just an SVG I took from https://clipboardjs.com/ (and it's the same as on GitHub clone copy icon)
